card.name: Pr- start of a word after a break
card.fires_on: The first piece "Pr" (or "PR"/"pr") of a word that begins a new phrase, such as Prerequisites, Prufrock, Pronged. It also fires on "entitled" after "book".

modes.label: Pr- opening a word
modes.description: The letters Pr start a word at a heading or name, with the rest of the word coming next.
modes.example: HI 211 History of Latin America <<Pr>>erequisite: EN 101.

modes.label: entitled after book
modes.description: The word entitled introduces the title of a book.
modes.example: this speech later became a book<< entitled>> ‘History Will Absolve Me’. F
